event_membership: Use frozen RF-row pose coordinates, half-open [low,high), t>=0; maximal contiguous RF-row runs, visit index 1-based. No GT error or outcome selection. At least 3 RF rows. New route RF runs mapped to motion [first included RF index,last included RF index+1). Pose truth is used solely to recover the already frozen geometric event membership, not to select new events.
arm_label: ORACLE_DIAGNOSTIC for all event interventions and event-conditioned tables; POWER1 is the unchanged causal reference

scope.decision: all motion samples t>=30 seconds; old route samples are all RF
additional: event entry through last included RF
scope.packet_window: entry-10 through end+30 seconds, actual RF rows only
scope.divergence: original minus SKIP wrapped heading degrees and gyro bias degrees/s at every motion sample in packet window
scope.growth: OLS natural-log absolute divergence versus seconds in first 10 seconds after event end; floors heading=1e-9 degrees, bias=1e-12 degrees/s; report floor hits and require >=3 samples

first_harmful_update: First accepted event update with increase in instantaneous wrapped heading squared error >=max(0.01 deg^2,10% of largest positive event update increase). If none, NONE_ABOVE_LOCKED_THRESHOLD. Attribute channel using 2*prior_error*channel_delta + channel_delta*total_delta (equal allocation of cross term); report wrap nonadditivity rather than conceal it. GT is offline diagnostic only.

verification.D4_covariance: Check every prior and posterior; any nonpositive eigenvalue is ERROR_NONSPD_NO_REPAIR, preserve other arms, no PSD repair

decision.supported: At least 3 of fixed 5 harmful events with positive canonical skip gain have D3/D4/D6 improvement >=50% of skip gain, with that same diagnostic worsening <=50% of SKIP worsening on ALL five fixed beneficial events. Beneficial skip sign changes or missing diagnostics leave safety NOT_ESTABLISHED; no events removed.
decision.falsified: At least 3 fixed harmful events have D1 or D2 recovery >=50% of positive skip gain and all D3/D4/D6 recovery <20%; errored or missing diagnostics cannot establish small effects.
decision.independence: No p-values; old R2/R4/R5 and C01-C03 share corridor, O01-O03 share one office. No independent-scene or hardware generalization. No normalized Bayesian posterior claim.
